name: mm2
signature: void mm2(long ni, long nj, long nk, long nl, double alpha, double beta, double *tmp, const double *A, const double *B, const double *C, double *D)
layout: A is an ni x nk matrix, B is nk x nj, C is nj x nl, D is ni x nl and tmp is ni x nj, all stored row-major: element (i, j) of a matrix with c columns is at index i*c + j. D is input and output: the function updates it starting from its initial values. tmp may be used as scratch space; its final contents are not checked. No two arrays overlap. All sizes are at least 1.
